descriptionChirho: To cause something to cease to exist or to lose its power, rendering it obsolete or no longer operative.
To render something legally or effectively void, making it of no force or authority, as in nullifying a law or promise.
To utterly overthrow or annihilate an opposing power, enemy, or force, stronger than simple abolishing.
To discharge or free someone from a binding obligation, law, or relationship so they are no longer bound.
To cut off or separate someone from a relationship or connection, resulting in alienation or estrangement.
